name: context7-admin
description: Manage Context7 from Codex: teamspace usage and spend, libraries and their benchmark scores, Docs7 sites and their builds, and Ask sites, with a console view in clients that show apps.

interface.shortDescription: Usage, libraries, Docs7 and Ask sites
interface.longDescription: Context7 Admin connects Codex to your Context7 teamspaces through the hosted Admin MCP server (sign in with Context7 on first use). See usage and spend, find the questions your docs answer badly and fix them in the repository, repair failed Docs7 builds, and set up Ask sites. In clients that show apps, open_console shows a summary card that expands to the full console.
defaultPrompt: Fix the docs questions my library fails.
Why did my last Docs7 build fail?
